section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: Causes of suicides The total number of suicide cases reported during 1982 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'Other 'causes' covers the unspecified causes of suicide sharing 52.0 per cent of the total suicides. Among the important causes of suicide 'Dreadful Diseases' was the major cause of suicide during 1982 which accounted for 14.8 per cent of total suicides. The second important 'cause of suicide' was 'Quarrel with parents-in-laws' (8.5%) followed by 'Quarrel with spouse' (6.3%), 'Love Affairs' (4.9%), 'Insanity' (3.2%), 'Poverty' (2.7%), 'Dispute over property' (1.8%), 'Failure in Examination' (1.7%) and 'Unemployment' (1.1%). Three causes viz., 'Bankruptcy' or sudden change in Economic 'position', 'Death of Dear Persons' and 'Fall in Social Reputation' each shared 1.0 per cent of the total 'suicides in India' during 1982.
